mapper.sql: select media_id, tmdb_id, media_type, imdb_id, mdl_id, letterboxd_slug, legacy_aid, title, original_title, overview, poster_path, poster_local_url, backdrop_local_url, backdrop_path, release_date, region, genres, tags, source, runtime, vote_average, vote_count, popularity, status, like_count, wish_count, watched_count, rating_avg, rating_count, hot_score, last_synced_at, visible, del_flag, feishu_doc_token, feishu_doc_url, tencent_doc_url, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from km_media
mapper.select:
select m.media_id, m.tmdb_id, m.media_type, m.imdb_id, m.mdl_id, m.title, m.original_title, m.overview, m.poster_path, m.poster_local_url, m.backdrop_path, m.release_date, m.region, m.genres, m.runtime, m.vote_average, m.vote_count, m.popularity, m.status, m.like_count, m.wish_count, m.watched_count, m.rating_avg, m.rating_count, m.hot_score, m.last_synced_at, m.visible, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time from km_media m
m.del_flag = '0' and m.visible = '0'
and exists (select 1 from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id
and (
r.platform like concat(#{pn}, '%')
)
and r.platform = #{platform} and r.offer_type = #{offerType} )
and m.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%') and m.media_type = #{mediaType} and m.region like concat('%', #{region}, '%') and m.genres like concat('%', #{genres}, '%') and year(m.release_date) = #{year}
and m.vote_average >= #{minRating} and m.rating_avg >= #{minRating} and (m.rating_avg >= #{minRating} or (coalesce(m.rating_avg, 0) = 0 and m.vote_average >= #{minRating}))
and ( coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) > curdate() or m.status in ('Planned', 'In Production', 'Post Production') )
and ( (m.media_type = 'tv' and m.status = 'Returning Series') or (m.media_type = 'movie' and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) <= curdate() and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 60 day)) )
and ( (m.media_type = 'tv' and m.status in ('Ended', 'Canceled')) or (m.media_type = 'movie' and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) is not null and coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) < date_sub(curdate(), interval 60 day)) )
order by ( (coalesce(m.vote_count,0) + coalesce(m.rating_count,0)) * coalesce(nullif(m.rating_avg,0), m.vote_average, 0) + 25 * 6.3 ) / (coalesce(m.vote_count,0) + coalesce(m.rating_count,0) + 25) desc, (coalesce(m.vote_count,0) + coalesce(m.rating_count,0)) desc order by m.popularity desc, m.hot_score desc order by coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = m.media_id), m.release_date) desc order by m.create_time desc order by m.hot_score desc, m.popularity desc

select m.media_id as mediaId, m.title, m.media_type as mediaType, m.poster_path as posterPath, m.poster_local_url as posterLocalUrl, m.release_date as releaseDate, m.region, m.rating_avg as ratingAvg, m.vote_average as voteAverage, r.country, max(r.online_date) as onlineDate, group_concat(distinct r.platform order by r.platform separator ',') as platforms, group_concat(distinct r.offer_type order by r.offer_type separator ',') as offerTypes, max(r.link) as link from km_media_release r join km_media m on m.media_id = r.media_id and m.del_flag = '0' and m.visible = '0' where r.source = 'justwatch' and r.online_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and r.online_date <= curdate() and r.country = #{country} group by m.media_id, r.country order by max(r.online_date) desc, m.media_id desc limit #{limit}

where del_flag = '0' and tmdb_id is not null and ( status in ('Planned', 'In Production', 'Post Production', 'Returning Series') or coalesce((select min(r.online_date) from km_media_release r where r.media_id = km_media.media_id), release_date) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 30 day) or media_id in (select s.media_id from km_user_subscription s where s.status = '0' and s.notified = '0') ) order by update_time asc, media_id asc limit #{limit}
select distinct year(release_date) y from km_media where del_flag = '0' and visible = '0' and release_date is not null order by y desc

select distinct r.platform from km_media_release r join km_media m on m.media_id = r.media_id and m.del_flag = '0' and m.visible = '0' where r.platform is not null and r.platform <> '' order by r.platform asc
select region from km_media where del_flag = '0' and visible = '0' and region is not null and region <> ''

select r.platform as platform, max(r.platform_logo) as logo from km_media_release r join km_media m on m.media_id = r.media_id and m.del_flag = '0' and m.visible = '0' where r.platform is not null and r.platform <> '' and r.platform_logo is not null group by r.platform

select media_id as mediaId, poster_local_url as posterLocalUrl, backdrop_local_url as backdropLocalUrl from km_media where del_flag = '0' and (poster_local_url like '/profile%' or backdrop_local_url like '/profile%')
mapper.insert: insert into km_media ( tmdb_id, media_type, imdb_id, mdl_id, letterboxd_slug, legacy_aid, title, original_title, overview, poster_path, poster_local_url, backdrop_path, release_date, region, genres, tags, source, runtime, vote_average, vote_count, popularity, status, hot_score, last_synced_at, visible, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{tmdbId}, #{mediaType}, #{imdbId}, #{mdlId}, #{letterboxdSlug}, #{legacyAid}, #{title}, #{originalTitle}, #{overview}, #{posterPath}, #{posterLocalUrl}, #{backdropPath}, #{releaseDate}, #{region}, #{genres}, #{tags}, ifnull(#{source}, 'tmdb'), #{runtime}, #{voteAverage}, #{voteCount}, #{popularity}, #{status}, #{hotScore}, #{lastSyncedAt}, ifnull(#{visible}, '0'), '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update km_media m set like_count = (select count(*) from km_user_media_action a where a.media_id = m.media_id and a.liked = '1'), wish_count = (select count(*) from km_user_media_action a where a.media_id = m.media_id and a.wished = '1'), watched_count = (select count(*) from km_user_media_action a where a.media_id = m.media_id and a.watched = '1'), rating_count = (select count(*) from km_user_media_action a where a.media_id = m.media_id and a.rating is not null), rating_avg = ifnull((select round(avg(a.rating),1) from km_user_media_action a where a.media_id = m.media_id and a.rating is not null), 0) where m.media_id = #{mediaId}
update km_media set hot_score = round( like_count * 3 + wish_count * 2 + watched_count * 2 + rating_avg * rating_count * 1.5 + popularity * 0.1 , 3) where media_id = #{mediaId}
mapper.delete:

#{mediaId}

select m.* from km_media m join km_user_media_action a on a.media_id = m.media_id and a.user_id = #{userId} where m.del_flag = '0'
and a.watched = '1' and a.rating is not null and a.liked = '1' and a.wished = '1'
order by a.update_time desc
